documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Thomas Scott India Limited held its Q4 and FY2026 earnings conference call on June 3, 2026, reporting a strong year with operating revenue of Rs. 255 crores, representing a 58% year-on-year growth. Management highlighted a 10th consecutive quarter of revenue growth, driven by their digital-first, test-and-scale model across 15+ brands and 50,000+ SKUs. During the discussion, management addressed questions regarding rising short-term borrowings, an insurance claim receivable from a previous fire incident, new category expansions like footwear, and gross margin improvements through product premiumization. Thomas Scott (India) Limited released its investor presentation for June 2026 detailing its evolution into a tech-enabled online fashion retailer with integrated manufacturing and fulfillment capabilities.

guidance.claim: Management targets EBITDA margins between 12% to 15% at any point in time.
guidance.quote: The growth will continue and we are targeting EBITDA margins between 12% to 15% at any point of time.

demand_outlook.claim: Consumer demand generally remained healthy throughout the quarter, supporting strong sales momentum across channels.
demand_outlook.quote: Consumer demand generally remained healthy throughout the quarter, supporting strong sales momentum across channels.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand conditions during the third quarter remained encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand conditions during the quarter remain encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Quarter 4 remains a generally upbeat quarter from a demand point of view.
demand_outlook.quote: Quarter 4 again remains a generally upbeat quarter from a demand point of view.

capex_expansion.claim: There are continuous expansion plans in the company's own capacity, especially in Sholapur.
capex_expansion.quote: There are continuous expansion plans in our own capacity, especially in Sholapur.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margins for the year stood at 7.57%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margins for the year stood at 7.57%.

margins_costs.claim: Other expenses escalated due to increased marketing initiatives for Diwali and Dussehra.
margins_costs.quote: Other expenses have largely escalated because of increased marketing initiatives on our side from a Diwali, Dussehra point of view.

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintains four manufacturing units with a total capacity of 140,000 pieces per month.
The company operates four fulfillment centers with a capacity of 15,000 pieces per day.

risks_headwinds.claim: An accidental fire at the Bhiwandi warehouse resulted in the loss of inventory and certain fixed assets.
risks_headwinds.quote: On 25th November 2025, an accidental fire resulted in the loss of inventory and certain fixed assets stored at that location.

risks_headwinds.claim: The carrying value of the inventory at the Bhiwandi warehouse was approximately Rs.21.85 crores.
risks_headwinds.quote: Yes, so the carrying value of the inventory at our warehouse in Bhiwandi has been disclosed in the notes to account at Rs.21.85 crores approximately.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to continue the past performance growth rate or better it by leaning into learnings.
management_commitments.quote: We intend to continue this performance or better it by leading into some of our learnings.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they are working towards continuing the baseline growth rate in the future for both own brands and licensed brands.
management_commitments.quote: What I can tell you is the baseline growth rate that we have given so far, we are working towards continuing that in the future and both channels, be it own brands, be it Thomas Scott brand would continue the same pace of growth.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they are working to make the top-line growth continue the same as last year.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are working to make the top line growth continue the same as last year.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they are targeting EBITDA margins between 12% to 15% at any point of time.
management_commitments.quote: The growth will continue and we are targeting EBITDA margins between 12% to 15% at any point of time.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
